channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Moving: Yeshiva students sing and pray in Sheba hospital
item.description: Yeshiva students sing and pray at Sheba Medical Center; Rosh Yehudi organization holds 'second hakafot' in Tel Aviv. Watch.

item.title: Hapoel Tel Aviv secures Winner Cup final
item.description: Hapoel Tel Aviv blew a double-digit lead before a clutch three-pointer and missed free throws helped them block Ness Ziona 88-86 and reach the Winner Cup final.

item.title: Yair Golan embarrasses opposition bloc
item.description: Democrats chair Yair Golan's proposal to include Ra'am in future coalition sparks disagreement with Yisrael Beytenu chairman, who rules out joining Arab parties in government.

item.title: Three years later: Nova massacre survivors dance with Torah scrolls
item.description: Survivors of the massacre at the Nova music festival on October 7 dance with their families at an event organized by the 'Kesher Yehudi' organization. Watch.

item.title: Three years later: Recording of Noa Marciano in Hamas captivity revealed
item.description: Three years later: Recording of Noa Marciano in Hamas captivity revealed

item.title: Watch: 'Second hakafot' at scene of the 7/10 Nova massacre
item.description: Attendees sing and dance emotionally at site where hundreds of young people were murdered at a music festival during the October 7 massacre, exactly three years ago.

item.title: Four protesters face expulsion after arrest in Samaria
item.description: Four protesters detained in Samaria on suspicion of disturbing public order and entering a closed military zone have been transferred for a hearing on possible expulsion from Israel.

item.title: EU condemns Israeli for illegally occupying cockpit of plane
item.description: The plane was trying to exercise its ancient rights of self-determination by creating facts on the ground.

item.title: London police urge students to move October 7 march
item.description: Pro-Palestinian students in London are planning a march in support of Palestinians specifically on October 7.

item.title: Watch: Jerusalem mayor attends 'second hakafot' at Machon Meir
item.description: Jerusalem Mayor Moshe Lion attends post-Simchat Torah 'second hakafot' at Machon Meir.

item.title: Galilee residents told to stay home amid Arab protests
item.description: Galilee residents told to stay home amid Arab protests

item.title: California to recognize 'Jewish' as ethnicity
item.description: Jewish groups hail California law making it the first state to list ‘Jewish’ as an ethnicity.

item.title: Eisenkot, Rabbi Granot honor fallen sons at 'second hakafot'
item.description: Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot joins post-holiday celebrations at Orot Shaul Yeshiva, where Rabbi Tamir Granot honors the memory of their sons, both of whom fell during the war.

item.title: Revealed: The Flydubai co-pilot who tried to crash the plane
item.description: New details emerge about the Omani co-pilot accused of attacking the captain and trying to seize control of a Flydubai flight, including his past employment, alleged radicalization and social media activity.

item.title: Three U.S. carriers, a chokepoint standoff, and Iran
item.description: Tehran’s maritime squeeze, Washington’s midterm political clock, and the rejection of Iran’s ceasefire offer have pushed the Strait of Hormuz to the brink. Navigating this standoff requires clear-eyed analysis of real operational limits, Arab diplomatic realities, and exact intelligence options. Opinion.

item.title: Flydubai captain: Co-pilot prayed minutes before attacking me
item.description: Indian pilot Smit Machchhar tells Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu how his Omani co-pilot prayed before launching a violent attack in the cockpit, leaving him barely able to see as the plane plunged.

item.title: Amb. Huckabee: 'I've never done something that heroic, but you have'
item.description: Ambassador Huckabee thanked Yaniv Hayoun, the Israeli plumber who helped to stabilize the Flydubai plane, and presented him with a signed cap from President Trump.

item.title: Netanyahu's surprising invitation to the Indian pilot
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu calls Indian flydubai captain Smit Machchhar, praising him as 'hero to Israel, India, and the entire world,' and extending special Independence Day invitation.

item.title: Emily Damari reveals: 'It's a miracle I'm alive'
item.description: Three years after she was kidnapped to Gaza during the October 7 massacre, former hostage Emily Damari shares disturbing photos from Shifa Hospital in Gaza, recalling her untreated wounds, terrifying captivity, and the miracle of her survival.

item.title: President Trump: 'Yaniv saved that flight yesterday, he did an amazing job'
item.description: US President Donald Trump posted a video in which he praised Yaniv, the Israeli plumber who helped save the Flydubai plane.

item.title: Iranian nationals arrested over alleged plot against UK Jews
item.description: Two Iranian nationals were arrested in the UK over an alleged plot to attack Manchester's Jewish community during Yom Kippur.

item.title: Flydubai hero pilot honored in UAE and India
item.description: Dubai's Crown Prince visits injured flydubai captain in the hospital, praising his courage after he helped save 174 passengers.

item.title: Watch: Rocket unit commander eliminated in Gaza
item.description: IDF eliminates two senior Islamic Jihad terrorists near Gaza City, after they worked to rebuild the group's military capabilities in violation of the ceasefire.

item.title: IDF targets 'Sinwar's heir'
item.description: Five killed in strike on Gaza City building as IDF targets Ali al-Amoudi, a senior Hamas terrorist who has risen to prominence since Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar's elimination.

item.title: Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and the the holidays of Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat, Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah at 18:58 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!

item.title: Senate secures vote on Trump’s Saudi nuclear deal
item.description:
US senators secure a vote on Trump’s proposed Saudi nuclear pact, with concerns over uranium enrichment and its potential impact on regional proliferation.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Neo-Nazi propaganda found outside Belleville synagogue days after shooting
item.description:
B’nai Brith Canada says neo-Nazi flyers were distributed around Belleville, including outside the synagogue targeted in a Yom Kippur shooting.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Report: Flydubai attacker had been banned from flying due to radicalization
item.description:
The Wall Street Journal reports that the Flydubai co-pilot who attacked his captain and sent an Israel-bound flight toward the ground had previously been barred from flying in Oman over radicalization concerns.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Nitzan Alon: 'We could have shortened the war and brought hostages home a year earlier'
item.description:
Maj. Gen. (res.) Nitzan Alon says Israel could have ended the Gaza war earlier and brought hostages home, while calling for new, realistic leadership.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Mamdani calls for US to join ICC, enforce Netanyahu arrest warrant
item.description:
In a podcast interview, New York Mayor renews his call for the US to join the ICC and enforce its arrest warrants, including the warrant against Netanyahu: “He’s the architect of a horrific genocide."
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)
